 Hulu has dropped the first trailer for “ Only Murders in the Building ” Season 6. 
 In the trailer, which can be seen below, the core three characters head to London to investigate the murder of fellow podcaster Cinda Canning. While they are expecting a whole different world upon their arrival, it turns out Jolly Old is more similar to their life in New York than they realized. 
 Along with stars Steve Martin, Martin Short, and Selena Gomez, the star-studded season’s cast also includes special guest stars include Tina Fey, Olivia Colman, Meryl Streep, David Tennant, Nicola Coughlan, Martin Freeman and more.

 As previously announced, Season 6 of the hit comedy series debuts on Dec. 8. The official description of the new season states: 
 “After successfully bringing the guilty to justice once again, Charles, Oliver and Mabel embark on their hardest case yet when the next victim — Cinda Canning — arrives at their doorstep, summoning them to London to catch her killer. Our beloved trio of true crime-solving podcasters must now navigate their way through the home of the cozy murder mystery, replete with a whole new collection of suspicious and particularly English-eccentric characters. But can they follow in the footsteps of the woman whose podcast started it all for them … without having their story end the same as hers?” 
 “Only Murders in the Building” hails from co-creators and writers Martin and John Hoffman. Hoffman and Martin also executive produce along with Short, Gomez, Dan Fogelman, Jess Rosenthal, Ben Smith, Jennifer Crittenden & Gabrielle Allan.
